example.romanization: Kì pot-sêu, oi hi khon yî-sên.
example.english: He has a fever, he needs to go see a doctor.

note: 發 (pot) here keeps a colloquial reading close to its literary root, distinct from how it appears in some compound words; 燒 (sêu) is the same character used for 'to burn/cook', so the word literally means 'burning up'.
